en.スイッチを押すと、順番に動き始めます。: When you press the switch, they start moving in order.
en.スタートのボタンを押します。玉、ドミノ、引き出しの順に動くことを確認します。: Press the start button. Make sure the ball moves, then the domino, and then the drawer.
en.速度を変えて、もう一度動かします。形はそのままで、動きの速さが変わります。: Change the speed and run it again. The shape remains the same, but the speed of movement changes.
en.途中でリセットします。古い動きが止まり、最初からやり直せれば成功です。: Reset in the middle. If the old movements stop and you can start over, you have succeeded.
en.Element.animate()はAnimationを返します。そのfinis: Element.animate() returns Animation. Awaiting for that finished allows the previous movement to complete before proceeding to the next process.
en.ドミノはfor...ofの中で1つずつawaitします。Promise.allに: Domino awaits one by one in for...of. This is different from the process that protects the order because it collapses at the same time as changing to Promise.all.
en.リセット時には進行中のAnimationをcancelし、generationも: At reset, the animation in progress will be canceled and the generation will also be updated. This is because even if the old process completes, it will not restart the subsequent movement.
en.chainの玉のanimate呼び出しの末尾にある係数1.5を3へ変更します。: Change the coefficient 1.5 at the end of the chain ball's animate call to 3.
en.玉が転がる区間だけが約2倍の時間になり、ドミノが倒れる区間の速さはそのままです。: Only the section where the ball rolls will take about twice as long, and the speed of the section where the dominoes fall will remain the same.
en.連鎖は衝突の計算ではなく、用意したアニメーションの順次再生です。物理シミュレーシ: Chaining is not a calculation of collisions, but a sequential playback of prepared animations. This code is not used for physical simulation.

en.文字をドラッグ、またはTabで選び矢印キーで移動。最大16文字。: Drag the text or select it with Tab and move it with the arrow keys. Maximum 16 characters.
en.短い言葉を入力して「文字を落とす」を押します。文字ごとの積み木が落ちます。: Enter a short word and press "Drop character". Building blocks for each letter will fall.
en.積み木を持ち上げて離し、箱をゆらして積み直します。: Lift the building blocks apart, shake the box, and re-stack it.
en.Tabで積み木を選び、矢印キーでも動かせます。入力には氏名などではなく、好きな短: You can select building blocks using Tab and move them using the arrow keys. Try using short words of your choice instead of your full name.
en.1文字ごとにSVGのグループを作り、位置・速度・ドラッグ中かどうかを保持します。: Creates an SVG group for each character and maintains position, speed, and whether or not it is being dragged. Adds gravity to the downward velocity every frame.
en.床では速度を反転して弱めます。ブロック同士は軸に沿った矩形として重なりを調べ、小: On the floor, reverse the speed and weaken it. Blocks are checked for overlap as rectangles along the axis, and pushed back to the axis where there is a small overlap.
en.1フレームで押し戻しを4回繰り返して積み重なりを調整します。全組み合わせを調べる: Repeat the push back four times in one frame to adjust the stacking. In order to examine all combinations, the number of characters is limited to 16.
en.lettersのstep内にあるb.vy+=1000*dtの1000を400へ変: Change 1000 of b.vy+=1000*dt in the letters step to 400.
en.積み木の落下がゆっくりになります。「文字を落とす」で初期状態からやり直し、変更前: The building blocks will fall more slowly. Start over from the initial state with "Drop text" and compare it with the drop before the change.
en.回転や複雑な形状は扱わない簡易シミュレーションです。多数の物体を安定して扱う本格: This is a simple simulation that does not handle rotations or complex shapes. It is not a substitute for a full-fledged physics engine that handles large numbers of objects reliably.
en.JavaScriptとSVGで磁石の引力アニメーションを作る｜Webの実験室: Create a magnet attraction animation with JavaScript and SVG | Web Laboratory
en.磁石に小物が吸い寄せられる。JavaScriptとSVGで引力のあるUIを作る: Small objects are attracted to the magnet. Create attractive UI with JavaScript and SVG
en.磁石をドラッグ。キーボードなら矢印キーで動かせます。: Drag the magnet. You can move it using the arrow keys on your keyboard.
en.中央の磁石をつかみ、右や左へ動かします。小物が磁石の周りへ集まれば成功です。: Grab the center magnet and move it to the right or left. It is a success if the small objects gather around the magnet.
en.反発に切り替え、磁石を小物へ近づけます。今度は小物が離れることを確かめます。: Switch to repulsion and bring the magnet closer to the small object. This time, make sure that the small items are separated.
en.強さを変え、同じ距離から小物を引き寄せて比べます。: Varying the strength, pull small objects from the same distance and compare.
en.各小物は位置x・yと速度vx・vyを持ちます。磁石との差分から方向と距離を求め、: Each small object has a position x and y and a velocity vx and vy. Find the direction and distance from the difference with the magnet, and add velocity in that direction.
en.距離が小さくなると力が急増するため、分母はMath.max(1600, d*d): Since the force increases rapidly as the distance decreases, we set a lower limit for the denominator with Math.max(1600, d*d). The deceleration for each frame is Math.exp(-3*dt).
en.SVGは表示サイズと内部座標が違います。getScreenCTM().inver: SVG has different display size and internal coordinates. Convert the finger position to SVG coordinates with getScreenCTM().inverse() and retain the operation while dragging with setPointerCapture.
en.magnetsのstep内にあるMath.exp(-3*dt)をMath.exp: Change Math.exp(-3*dt) in the step of magnets to Math.exp(-6*dt). Change both the x and y directions.
en.同じ設定で磁石を動かすと、小物の勢いが弱くなり、止まりやすくなります。変更前後は: If you move the magnet with the same settings, the momentum of the small object will be weaker, making it easier to stop. Before and after the change, use "Rearrange small items" to align the initial positions and compare.
en.見た目を楽しむための近似です。物理的な磁場を再現しているわけではなく、小物同士の: This is an approximation for visual enjoyment. It does not reproduce the physical magnetic field, nor does it calculate collisions between small objects.

en.ランプの位置を左右に動かし、机の影が逆方向へ動く様子を見ます。: Move the lamp from side to side and watch the shadow of the desk move in the opposite direction.
en.ランプを消したり、ブラインドを開けたりして、1つずつ状態を変えて比べます。: Change the conditions one by one by turning off the lamp or opening the blinds and compare.
en.nightとlampという2つの状態と、スライダーや選択欄の値をdraw()に集: Collect the two states night and lamp and the values of the slider and selection field in draw(). By gathering the drawings in one place, you can avoid discrepancies between the button labels and the pictures.
en.影の中心は350-x*.65、横幅は65+Math.abs(x)*.3です。ラン: The center of the shadow is 350-x*.65 and the width is 65+Math.abs(x)*.3. The shadow is shifted in the opposite direction according to the amount of movement of the lamp, and spread out by the distance.
en.光の三角形はopacityで強さを表現します。ブラインドはtranslateとs: The triangle of light expresses strength with opacity. The blinds use a combination of translate and scale to create an open look.
en.studyのdraw内で影の中心を決める350-x*.65を350-x*1.0に: Change 350-x*.65, which determines the center of the shadow, to 350-x*1.0 in the study draw.
en.ランプを同じだけ動かしても、影がより大きく左右へ移動します。影の大きさを決めるr: Even if you move the lamp the same amount, the shadow will move more left and right. Since RX, which determines the size of the shadow, is not changed, you can notice the difference in position.
en.光線を追跡するレンダリングではなく、式でそれらしく見せる2D表現です。実際の影の: It is not a rendering that traces light rays, but a 2D expression that uses formulas to make it look like it. Actual shadow shape and light occlusion are not calculated.

en.たとえば、ある波形の区間から画像を作り、さらに加工したサンプルを用意するとします: Suppose you turn a waveform interval into an image and then create derived samples. Even with different filenames, placing derivatives of the same source in training and test sets can lead to a misleading evaluation.
en.SplitTraceは、サンプルID・親ID・被験者ID・区間などのメタデータを: SplitTrace reads metadata such as sample IDs, parent IDs, subject IDs and intervals to audit existing splits. Its central feature is tracing source relationships and showing the path behind a finding.
en.同梱サンプルでは、次の2つの経路が同じ元サンプルにつながります。: In the included sample, these two paths reach the same source sample.
en.大切なのは、情報が足りない項目を「問題なし」にしないこと。親子関係や必要なメタデ: Missing information should not be treated as a clean result. If parent relationships or required metadata are missing, the report shows limits in its coverage. This tool checks declared relationships and policies; it does not infer provenance from waveforms or images.
en.時系列の検出では、正解イベントの少し後に予測が出ることがあります。それを正解とし: In time-series detection, a prediction may arrive shortly after the true event. Whether that counts as a match changes the score.
en.EventScore Explorerは、正解と予測の区間をCSVで受け取り、対: EventScore Explorer accepts truth and prediction intervals in CSV and creates an HTML report of matches, misses and false alarms. Switch tolerances to compare the matching events and scores.
en.EventScore Explorerの合成デモを開く: Open the EventScore Explorer synthetic demo
en.デモ上部の「Endpoint tolerance (seconds)」を0から0: At the top of the demo, change Endpoint tolerance (seconds) from 0 to 0.5.
en.同梱デモは、正解4件・予測5件。許容時間0秒では対応2件、誤検出3件、見逃し2件: The demo has four truth events and five predictions. With zero tolerance, there are two matches, three false alarms and two misses. At 0.5 seconds, there are three matches, two false alarms and one miss. The predictions stay the same; the evaluation rule changes the result.
en.ここでは、1つの正解に1つの予測だけを対応づけ、対応数が最大になる組み合わせを探: Each truth event can match only one prediction, and the algorithm maximizes the number of matches. Tolerance applies to the gap between intervals. At zero seconds, touching endpoints do not count as overlap. This is a tool for inspecting an explicit policy, not a standard evaluation protocol for a particular subject group or disease.

zh-cn.同梱デモは、正解4件・予測5件。許容時間0秒では対応2件、誤検出3件、見逃し2件: 演示包含 4 个真实事件和 5 个预测。容差为 0 秒时，匹配 2 个、误报 3 个、漏检 2 个；改为 0.5 秒后，匹配 3 个、误报 2 个、漏检 1 个。预测本身没有变化，改变结果的是评估规则。
zh-cn.ここでは、1つの正解に1つの予測だけを対応づけ、対応数が最大になる組み合わせを探: 一个真实事件最多对应一个预测，算法寻找匹配数量最多的组合。容差作用于区间之间的间隙；为 0 秒时，仅端点接触不算重叠。这是帮助检查明确规则的工具，并非针对某一人群或疾病的标准评估方案。
